jobs.title: Restaurant Operations - Cologne/Düsseldorf
jobs.description: About Us Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland. About the Role: We’re looking for a true startup Operations person. Good onboarding is what makes our merchants set up for success. From the first meeting, the go-live to working and growing together - this person will own the onboarding process and make it all happen. This role is for someone who likes working with the product, becoming an expert in it and teaching others. Your day-to-day will be a mix of hands-on ops, project management, customer communication and problem solving. We are reshaping the future of hospitality tech, and this role is at the forefront of it. What You’ll Do: Our Operations happen on a restaurant floor, in a lively neighbourhood, at a busy bar - we operate in the city: Run restaurant onboarding: train, connect and implement together with the restaurant team Problem-solve for our merchants on the ground while running live operations Support restaurants after the go live and make sure that Tebi adds value to their business long-term Find opportunities for improvement in our process, materials and systems Continue investing in our relationship with our merchants to make sure they are happy with our product and growing as a business Identify product and process gaps and bring it to internal ce

jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.description: About Act There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. About the Role You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most. We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment. What You Will Be Doing Drive high-priority initiatives across the business. Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges. Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows. Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution. Research new markets, products, and business opportunities. Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions. Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes. What You Will Need Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment. Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges. Comfortable working across different business functions. Strong ownership and execution skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment. Curious, resource

jobs.description: The Learning Team at ClickHouse is growing fast as more users discover the power of ClickHouse and seek to understand how to use it effectively. As a Training Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for coordinating, managing, and supporting the logistics and administration of global training programs, with a focus on public and private instructor-led training events. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless event execution and a consistent, high-quality learner experience. What you will be doing: Here is a list of the typical tasks you would be performing as a Training Operations Specialist: Schedule and organize virtual and in-person training events, including registration page setup, Zoom configuration, and email communications. Coordinate training event logistics, including sourcing and booking venues, managing event requirements, coordinating instructor availability, and communicating with instructors and attendees. Manage event registration, monitor enrollment, send reminders, follow-up emails, and track attendance to ensure smooth event execution. Track and report training metrics, registration trends, attendance, and program outcomes to key stakeholders. Partner with Field Marketing teams to coordinate public training events, including event scheduling, registration monitoring, and promotional support. Collaborate with Sales teams to coordinate private training requests, manage scheduling and logistics, and support customer training needs. Work closely with the broader Training team to coordinate resources, streamline processes, and ensure consistent execution across training programs. Requirements: 2+ years of experience in training coordination, operations, event management, or a related role. jobs.title: People Experience Ops Partner (R6561)
jobs.description: Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and About the team The People Experience (PX) Operations team supports a seamless employee lifecycle across onboarding, offboarding, employee data management, leave administration, benefits support, and compliance reporting. We partner with employees, managers, and cross-functional teams across Shield AI’s international locations to ensure that core people processes are accurate, timely, locally compliant, and employee-centered. About the role The People Experience Operations Partner owns day-to-day people operations for employees across assigned international countries. This role manages employee lifecycle processes, country-specific employment documentation, employee changes, leave and benefits administration, and operational coordination with Payroll, Finance, Legal, and external providers.
